_comment: Cursor sandbox.json — controls network and filesystem access for agent (Background Agent / auto-run) sessions. Place at .cursor/sandbox.json in the repository root. Team-admin settings override workspace settings, which override user settings.

networkPolicy._comment: default: deny blocks all outbound network unless explicitly allowed. Recommended for regulated environments. Use 'allow' only for low-sensitivity projects.

_security_notes: RFC 1918 private IP ranges, cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254), and IPv6 private ranges are always blocked by Cursor and cannot be overridden here.
Set networkPolicy.default to 'deny' and explicitly allowlist only required package registries.
Never add 'deny' entries as the sole protection — always combine with a restrictive 'default: deny' posture.
The additionalReadwritePaths list grants the agent write access outside the workspace. Keep it empty unless you have a specific, reviewed use case.
This file should be committed to the repository. Review changes to it with the same rigor as CI/CD config changes.
